one_line: Google-integrated CRM with a RESTful 'Developer API' (JSON) covering people, companies, opportunities, tasks, and leads.
auth_notes: API key (X-API-Key header) for server integrations; OAuth2 also supported. API at https://api.copper.com/developer_api/ with Postman collection available. Domain changed from api.prosperworks.com (auto-redirects until early 2022).
self_serve_notes: Paid plans required; API keys are issued per account. No free tier documented for API access.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: People, companies, opportunities, leads, tasks, activities, pipelines, custom fields; smaller surface than major CRMs
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks/triggers supported for record change events (integration triggers)

existing_mcp.note: No official Copper MCP server found; community servers exist

evidence.note: Fetched getting-started page confirmed REST/JSON API, API domain, Postman resources; auth details partly from knowledge

agent_notes: Fetched page focused on getting started/Postman; auth method specifics (API key header vs OAuth) from knowledge.
